name: claude-code
description: Claude Code as an iii worker: headless turns over the iii bus and a terminal page on the console, both on one login. Raw messages on the claude::on-raw-event function, AgentEvent frames on claude::on-agent-event.

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:iii-plugin && tsc -b
scripts.build:bundle: npm run build:ui && npm run build:iii-plugin && node scripts/build-bundle.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:ui && npm run build:iii-plugin && tsc -b --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && npm run build:iii-plugin && tsx src/index.ts
